# capacitor-device-profile

> A small mobile and foldable runtime for web apps and games in a Capacitor shell: a device profile
> (phone, foldable-open, tablet, desktop) that re-classifies live on fold and unfold, an orientation
> rule that never force-rotates, live safe-area insets, an app lifecycle with a back-button stack,
> and a haptics facade. No runtime dependencies; Capacitor plugins are passed in.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://jonbogaty.com/capacitor-device-profile/): the published, browsable version of everything below.
- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/capacitor-device-profile/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, API overview.
- [API reference](https://github.com/jbcom/capacitor-device-profile/blob/main/docs/API.md): every export, with the exact classification rules.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/capacitor-device-profile/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): module boundaries, invariants, intentional limits.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jbcom/capacitor-device-profile/blob/main/AGENTS.md): toolchain, invariants not to violate, doc/test sync obligations.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jbcom/capacitor-device-profile/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): local setup, the `pnpm verify` gate, commit and release conventions.
